ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity on September 28, 2026, repurchasing 25,000 equity shares at an average price of ₹288.41. This contributes to a cumulative total of 1,663,324 shares bought back as part of an ongoing open market program, which aims to return capital to shareholders and potentially enhance earnings per share by reducing outstanding shares. The report is a routine regulatory filing, and no material red flags are evident in this daily disclosure.
